location_name: Old drainage opening, downslope from the Pell farm/quarry track
description_public: A narrow old drainage opening in a rock face, reached by following an intermittent trail of overlapping impressions through loose shale and brush. Dhovir and Mira have not entered it yet.
environment: Rough loose shale, brush, old quarry terrain; interior not yet assessed.
hazards: Interior of the drainage opening is unassessed
objectives_public: Decide whether and how to enter the drainage opening
Find out what happened to the missing travelers
unresolved_questions_public: Who is using the abandoned workings, and why?
dm_notes: DM truth (dm_private): a small band of deserters led by Hask Renn has been using the drainage tunnels to rob travelers; Hask disturbed a sealed chamber and released a weak supernatural presence. Orren Vale is a covert deserter contact. None of this is established to the players yet.
